meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 17 (DECISIONS 039, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new JBL models, 16 quotes, 1 identifier verified (Flip 7 Black — UPC 050036407342 + MPN JBLFLIP7BLKAM; the other 4 stay pending — see catalog notes). JBL US storefront sweep 2026-11-06 (BUILD_LOG 055): the jbl.com homepage text fetch returned only a locale prompt, so the sweep is recorded from search-index reads of the US storefront and category pages — the shelf shows Flip 7, Charge 5, Live 780NC, Flip Essential 2, Sense Lite, PartyBox Club 120, PartyBox 130, Clip 5, Tune 730BT and the EON700 pro line; the 5 added are the Flip 7 (portable speaker, Black), Tour One M3 Smart Tx (flagship over-ear ANC headphones, Black), Tour Pro 3 (flagship true-wireless earbuds, Black), Bar 1300XMK2 (flagship 11.1.4 soundbar, Black) and PartyBox Stage 320 (wheeled party speaker, Black) — one per product family, the first JBL entries and the first speakers / soundbar / party speaker in the set. STALE FEED PRICES: the Meta feed's Abt $229.95 Tour Pro 3 Black row conflicts with the live Abt page ($329.95) and was excluded (A2933 $135 precedent); the Best Buy Tour One M3 $199.95 sale (Slickdeals, ~8 days ago) has ended — the Best Buy page now shows $449.95 and the JBL feed row shows $449.95. SALE vs LIST: JBL direct Flip 7 is $129.95 on sale ($20 off the $149.95 list — product-page JSON-LD InStock + Meta feed Black row $129.95 vs $149.95 list). US vs NON-US: the US soundbar is the Bar 1300XMK2 (12-inch sub, 1570W max); the non-US Bar 1300MK2 (dual 8-inch sub, 2470W) is a different regional variant and was not added. No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced identifiers (the Tour Pro 3 Black UPC 050036402392 appears on Amazon listings only and was not recorded; the Bar 1300XMK2 UPC 050036414869 appears on Amazon + an eBay refurbished listing + Target Plus partner data and was not recorded). Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{jbl-flip-7-black,jbl-tour-one-m3-smart-tx-black,jbl-tour-pro-3-black,jbl-bar-1300xmk2-black,jbl-partybox-stage-320-black}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored).
